title: Destiny's Twin
next_chapter_hook: In the depths of the secret realm, that familiar voice rang out once again—"You've finally arrived." Chen Ji gripped the fragment in his hand, knowing that what he was about to face might well be the greatest tribulation of his life.

text.content: In the instant his eyes met those of his other self in the web of fate, Chen Ji heard a voice from the future—"You've finally arrived." The voice was low and familiar, as if echoing from beyond the shores of time, carrying an indescribable vicissitude. Instinctively, he tightened his grip on the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, his fingertips throbbing with pain. The golden patterns on the fragment were flickering violently, as if some ancient seal was being gradually dismantled.

dialogue.content: "Be careful." Mo Xiansheng's residual soul violently trembled within his Mental Sea, his voice unusually grave—"That is the manifestation of the Destined Twin... In that instant, you glimpsed your other path of destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji steadied his mind, his gaze piercing through the mist before him. The entrance to the secret realm lay just a hundred zhang away—that jet-black fissure resembled a wound in heaven and earth, its edges crackling with lightning, faintly resonating with Buddhist chants. And standing motionless at the very center of the fissure was a blurred figure—identical to him yet fundamentally different, as if existing in some mirror image.

"Another me?" Chen Ji murmured softly, his brow slightly furrowing. The warning from the Tianji Record had never been so intense—it was a repulsion from deep within destiny itself, as if two forces of the same origin were clashing against each other. A thought from Mo Xiansheng flashed through his mind: The bearer of the Tianji Record has never been only one.

dialogue.content: At that moment, an invisible gaze suddenly fell upon Chen Ji. That gaze was cold and vast, as if a deity above all creation was examining an ant. The fissure in the sky suddenly expanded, and a massive eye slowly emerged from its depths—the pupil was pure gold, reflecting both Chen Ji's form and the figure entangled with his fate.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. That eye—the Heavenly Dao Eye! It was more real and more terrifying than anything he had ever witnessed in his visions. The golden pupil was slowly rotating, as if surveying every corner of this heaven and earth, and its gaze was fixed precisely upon where he stood. A shiver of primordial fear instantly spread throughout his entire body.

"It's searching for you." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying an undeniable urgency—"The Heavenly Dao Eye never gazes upon mortals without reason... The Tianji Record Fragment you carry has already drawn its attention." Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining visibly before his eyes, as if some invisible force was siphoning away his luck.

The entrance to the secret realm lay before his eyes, that jet-black fissure exuding an alluring presence, as if silently beckoning the destined to enter. Yet the figure entangled with his fate remained motionless at the fissure's center, as if awaiting something. Wind howled forth from the fissure, carrying an ancient and desolate aura that caused Chen Ji's heart to involuntarily quicken.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you have two choices." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and solemn—"First, while the Heavenly Dao Eye has yet to lock onto your aura, withdraw immediately. With your current arrangements, you can lie in wait in the shadows for far longer. Second, enter the secret realm and confront the truth of the Destined Twin—but prepare yourself, for once you enter, it becomes a true life-and-death game."

choice.prompt: Faced with the Heavenly Dao Eye's oppressive might and the Destined Twin's summoning, Chen Ji had to make a choice: risk death to enter the secret realm and uncover the truth, or temporarily retreat and preserve his strength for the future?

choices.description: Confront the summons of destiny, whether the path ahead holds fortune or peril, personally uncover the truth of the Destined Twin. Retreat has never been Chen Ji's style.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao Eye's gaze will become clearer, and destiny's inevitable backlash will intensify
choices.process_label: 踏入秘境，与命运正面对决

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, the hesitation in his eyes flickering briefly before being replaced by some unyielding resolve. He took his first step toward the secret realm's entrance. Each step was as heavy as a mountain, the Heavenly Dao Eye's gaze prickling his back like thorns, yet he showed not the slightest sign of retreat. A废物? Heh, Chen Ji has never been some lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

The moment he stepped onto the edge of the fissure, a sensation of vertigo instantly overwhelmed him. Countless images flashed before his eyes like a carousel—memories of past lives, possibilities of futures, countless interwoven threads of fate... And at the end of all those visions, the figure identical to him slowly turned around, revealing a knowing smile.

choices.description: A gentleman does not stand beneath a crumbling wall. Rather than recklessly courting death, better to retreat a step and use the Tianji Record's foresight to strategize for the future. A piece that is alive still has value.
choices.visible_reward: Preserved Heavenly Fate Value, Gained Strategic Buffer Time
choices.risk_hint: The truth of the Destined Twin will continue to be shrouded in mist

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, yet the light in his eyes did not dim. He was never some impulsive fool—a true strong one knows when to advance and when to retreat. So what if the Heavenly Dao Eye gazes upon him? The stronger it is, the more valuable it proves Chen Ji to be. What's the rush? The grand performance has only just begun.

Just as he turned around, the figure at the secret realm's entrance suddenly moved. It raised its head, gazing toward Chen Ji's direction, lips slightly parting as if speaking. Though separated by layers of mist, Chen Ji clearly understood those silent words—'Next time we meet, it's life or death.'

Regardless of what choice Chen Ji made, the gaze of the Heavenly Eye did not diminish. That enormous golden pupil slowly rotated, as if recording everything happening in this moment. The gears of fate had already begun to turn, and Chen Ji—whether he stepped into that crack or not—had been drawn into a chess game far beyond his imagination.

dialogue.content: At that moment, a voice suddenly echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—not Mo Xiansheng's voice, but another existence far colder and more transcendent. 'Where do you think you can escape to? The fragments of the Tianji Record will ultimately reunite as one.' That voice came from the Heavenly Eye, carrying irresistible might.

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps halted. He slowly raised his head, confronting that massive eye dominating the nine heavens. His eyes held no fear, only a faint cold smile. 'Reunite as one?' he silently thought. 'Let's see who finally reunites them.' The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew slightly warm, as if responding to his will.

choice.prompt: The will of the Heavenly Eye had descended, and Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this transcendent existence: confront it directly to display his defiance, or remain silent to preserve his strength?

choices.description: What of the Heavenly Eye? Chen Ji has never bowed to any existence in this lifetime. Today, let me show you just how much turmoil this fragment can stir!
choices.visible_cost: Fully exposed under the Heavenly Eye's gaze
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record Fragment gains temporary [Destiny Resistance] enhancement
choices.risk_hint: May trigger Heaven's direct punishment mechanism

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped, turning to face that vast golden pupil. His eyes held no reverence, only a confidence bordering on madness. 'You want my Tianji Record?' His voice echoed in his Mental Sea. 'Come take it then.' The golden patterns on the fragment suddenly erupted with brilliant light, shooting toward the heavens, colliding head-on with the Heavenly Eye's gaze.

choices.description: Exchanging insults with Heaven? Chen Ji wasn't foolish enough for that. A true strong one never boasts in the moment; he was waiting—for that chance to strike back.
choices.visible_reward: Gain [Power of Endurance], next Foresight consumption reduced by 10%
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may therefore look down on him even more

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely standing silently, allowing that transcendent gaze to sweep over him. His eyes were calm as still water, as if nothing had happened. But deep within his heart, a seed named 'revenge' was quietly taking root. Heavenly Eye, remember this well—the humiliation of today will be repaid tomorrow.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the golden patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment were quietly changing. Those originally blurry runes gradually became clear, as if responding to fate's call. And at the secret realm's entrance, the figure entangled with Chen Ji's destiny finally turned completely, facing his direction. On that identical face, a meaningful smile appeared.

'You've finally arrived.' That voice rang out again, different from its previous ethereal quality—this time extraordinarily clear. It was Chen Ji's own voice, yet carrying an unfamiliar coldness. Chen Ji's heart rate suddenly accelerated, and he suddenly realized that the confrontation between fate's twins might come faster and more brutal than he had imagined.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out, carrying an unprecedented solemnity, 'Before you make your final decision, there are things you must know—about the fate's twins, about the true inheritance of the Tianji Record... and about your sister Chen Nian's whereabouts.'

choice.prompt: It seemed Mo Xiansheng had mastered key information about the fate's twins and Chen Nian. Chen Ji must decide: immediately pursue the truth, or first handle the threat of the secret realm before him?

choices.description: The name Chen Nian emerged, and Chen Ji's heart instantly tightened. His sister was his only weakness, and the final bottom line of his grand scheme to manipulate the world. Whatever the cost, he must know the truth.
choices.visible_cost: Delaying the timing of entering the secret realm
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal moment to converse with the Destiny Twin

dialogue.content: "Chen Nian..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. The man who had always been as cold as ice finally revealed a hint of vulnerability when he heard his sister's name. "Tell me, where is she?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment before finally speaking: "She is deep within the secret realm—as the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the place where she is imprisoned is precisely where the Destiny Twin was born."

choices.description: He never forgot about Chen Nian for even a single moment, but now was not the time to press for answers. The variables within the secret realm were too many—he must first ensure he survives to leave, only then would he have the chance to save his sister.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily shelve the clues about Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Maintain initiative over the secret realm
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's situation may further deteriorate

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the surging emotions within. Chen Nian... he silently recited her name in his heart—one day, he would take his younger sister back from those people's hands. But not now, not here. He raised his head, his gaze falling once more on the figure intertwined with his destiny at the secret realm entrance, a cold smile curving his lips. "Let's go."

Chen Ji strode forward, heading toward the secret realm entrance. Every step fell upon the strings of destiny, producing silent thunderclaps. The Heavenly Eye's gaze followed like a shadow, the Destiny Twin's smile growing ever clearer, and the chess game in his heart had finally reached its most critical moment. The waste disciple of Tianqing Sect? Hmph, from this day forward, this title would be forever consigned to history. Replacing it would be a name that made the world tremble—Chen Ji.

The moment Chen Ji stepped through the secret realm entrance, the world seemed to freeze. All sounds, all light, all cause and effect crystallized in that instant. His consciousness traversed endless darkness, finally arriving at a strange space—here there was no sky, no earth, only endless stars and interwoven lines of fate. And at the terminus of those fate lines, two figures stood silently—one was himself, the other... was his Destiny Twin.

dialogue.content: "You've finally come." The figure identical to him spoke, its voice carrying an indescribable complexity. "I've been waiting for you... for such a long, long time." Chen Ji stared directly into those eyes identical to his own, seeing within them endless cycles, endless struggles, endless destiny. His Destiny Twin now stood before him, awaiting this fated confrontation.

text.content: Deep within the secret realm, that familiar voice rang out once more—"You've finally come." Chen Ji gripped the fragment in his hand tightly, knowing that what he was about to face might be the greatest tribulation of his life. The truth of the Destiny Twin, the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, Chen Nian's whereabouts... all the mysteries would be revealed in this moment. And he, Chen Ji, would personally rewrite this predetermined destiny.
